title: The Unravelling
text: A thread hangs in the dark, fine as hair and shining faintly. Pulling it unravels something, perhaps the dark, perhaps you. You can feel it tugging gently at you from somewhere behind your ribs.

options.label: The Leader pulls the thread to learn what unravels.

outcomes.text: The dark unravels a little. There is light behind it.
You unravel a little, and the thread keeps coming.

options.label: Cut the thread before it pulls anything else apart.

outcomes.text: It whips back, and the dark tightens. Something in it is awake.

options.label: The wisest ties it off so nothing comes undone.

outcomes.text: Once it is tied the dark holds still, and you learn how it is made.
